1.title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Claims About the Effect of the Iran War on Oil Prices, Munitions and More
1.summary: The president misleadingly blamed the Biden administration’s weapons transfers to Ukraine for current concerns over munitions stockpiles, among other claims about the Iran war.

2.title: How Ukraine Is Making Inroads With MAGA and a Trump Ally, Laura Loomer
2.summary: Ukraine and its supporters have invested years in trying to undo the skepticism of the country’s war effort harbored by President Trump’s MAGA movement and the president himself.

3.title: She Voted for a Justice Who Overturned Roe. Now it Haunts Her on the Trail.
3.summary: Senator Susan Collins, who supports abortion rights, endorsed Brett Kavanaugh’s nomination for the Supreme Court. It has emerged as a major issue in her campaign for re-election.

4.title: Search Continues for Missing Climbers After Pakistan Avalanche
4.summary: Three climbers, including an American, from a group of 10 died after the avalanche struck on Thursday, officials said. The fate of renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja was still unclear.

5.title: Spain attacks 'selfish' response of some EU countries to Ceuta migrant crossings
5.summary: Italy has temporarily suspended the Schengen arrangement with Spain as Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called scenes in Ceuta "shocking".

6.title: Kuwait Says It Downed Iranian Drones as Mideast Braces for Possible Escalation
6.summary: The wave of strikes came as President Trump threatened to intensify the U.S. campaign against Iran, with both sides showing little sign of backing down.
